{"caption":"I have the 16 Pro, 17 Pro, and 18 Pro, so I shot the same things on all three to figure out who should actually upgrade.

Each year changed a different part of the camera. The 17 Pro was about zoom and selfies, with a zoom lens four times sharper and a front camera that auto-rotates and reframes. The 18 Pro changed none of that. Same zoom lens, same sensor. What’s new is a main camera that physically opens and closes, pulling in about 50 percent more light at night or closing down to keep more of the scene sharp, plus manual control for the first time.

On a 16 Pro, upgrade. You get two years at once. On a 17 Pro, only if you shoot low light or want manual control. And the 16 Pro actually zooms further than both.

Save this before you buy and send it to your friend who upgrades every single year.
